behavior: A strongly migratory, vocal, colonial tern with buoyant rowing flight; forages singly or in flocks by picking prey from the surface or plunge-diving for small fish, and vigorously defends its nesting territory.
field_marks: Full black breeding cap surrounding a dark eye
Slender, straight orange-red bill, usually with a black tip
Pale gray upperparts and white to very light gray underparts
Long, narrow, pointed wings with darker outer primaries
Deeply forked tail with elongated outer feathers
habitat: Breeds colonially on rocky islands, barrier beaches, saltmarshes, and sparsely vegetated sand, gravel, shell, or cobble near water. Forages over coastal waters, estuaries, inlets, and large inland lakes; chiefly marine outside the breeding season.
